name: spring-boot-service
description: Starter: a Spring Boot 4.0.9 service on Java 21 (Spring Initializr shape: Maven, web MVC, actuator) with a page about itself, /health, /api/info and /api/connections, and a Dockerfile that builds it with Maven and runs it on the Temurin 21 JRE. Deployed with deployment rules such as k8s-deploy.
